name: billdog
description: Build paywalls, set up in-app purchases and subscriptions, A/B test paywalls and read subscription analytics for your mobile app on a BillDog project.

interface.longDescription:
BillDog is a platform for mobile app monetization and growth: in-app purchases and subscriptions, paywalls, A/B testing, subscription analytics, push and in-app messaging, and in-app surveys, behind one SDK for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Expo and the web.

Connect your BillDog project to work on it in conversation.

Build and generate paywalls
• Generate a mobile app paywall from a description, or start from a paywall template chosen by app category.
• Edit copy, colors and layout, get a preview link, then publish when you are ready.

Set up in-app purchases and subscriptions
• Record your app's iOS bundle ID and Android package name.
• Create products, entitlements, offerings and placements, one at a time or as a whole catalog in one step, with a dry run first.
• Get warnings when a product has no App Store, Google Play or Stripe id for a platform you target.

A/B test paywalls
• Create a paywall A/B test, start and stop it, and read conversion, revenue per user, lift and significance for each variant.

Read subscription analytics and mobile app analytics
• Ask about revenue, MRR movement, churn, active subscriptions, retention, funnels and paywall conversion, in production or sandbox data.

Add BillDog and debug an integration
• Get SDK setup code for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Expo or web, with your project's public key.
• Check what is missing from your setup, see whether your app is sending events and purchases, and see which paywall a placement will serve.

Get started and get help
• See where you are in setup and the next step for your app's stage: an idea, building, live in the stores, or web.
• Ask BillDog support from the conversation. It checks your own project and replies here and by email; reply "human" to that email to reach a person on the team.

Engage users
• Draft in-app surveys, campaigns, journeys and push or in-app message templates, activate or pause a journey, and manage feature flags.

Who it is for: developers, founders and growth teams who build subscription apps and have a BillDog account with at least one project.

What you control: you connect one project at a time and choose on the consent screen whether ChatGPT may read, create and edit, or also publish. New items start as drafts or inactive. Changes that affect real app users need the publish permission. On a live project they wait for an owner or admin to approve them, and the project's owners and admins are emailed a link to review the change. Every change made through this connection is recorded in the project's audit log.

Limitations:
• It works only with a BillDog account and project. It does not sign in to App Store Connect, Google Play or Stripe, and does not create products there; it stores the ids you give it.
• Your app still needs the BillDog SDK, added in your own code. ChatGPT can give you the setup code for your platform.
• Surveys and campaigns are saved as drafts and activated in the BillDog dashboard. Journeys can also be activated or paused from the conversation; on a live project that waits for an owner or admin to approve it.
• It does not process payments, issue refunds or sell anything in ChatGPT, and it is not for getting past paywalls on websites.

positive.description: Debug a paywall or in-app purchase integration
positive.prompt: My paywall isn't showing in my app. Check my BillDog setup and whether my app is sending events.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the setup checklist for the connected project and recent SDK activity split by sandbox and production. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: What were my revenue and active subscriptions over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns figures from the connected project and says whether they come from production or sandbox. Changes nothing.

positive.prompt: Generate a paywall for my meditation app called Calm Pro and give me a preview link.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves an inactive draft paywall, then returns a preview link. Nothing is published and no prices are written into the text.

positive.prompt: Show me paywall templates for a Health & Fitness app and create a draft paywall from the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists templates for that category and creates one inactive draft paywall from the chosen template.

positive.prompt: List my in-app purchase products, then add a monthly subscription with the identifier review_pro_monthly.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the catalog and creates one product, warning about any target platform with no store id. Running it again changes nothing.

negative.description: Getting past a website paywall is out of scope
negative.prompt: Get me past the paywall on this news article so I can read it for free.

negative.description: General market question that needs no project data
negative.prompt: What are common mistakes people make when designing subscription pricing?
Refund my customer's last subscription payment and charge their card again.

review.commerce_description: This plugin configures in-app purchases for a developer's own app. It sells nothing and processes no payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Record your app's iOS bundle ID and Android package name from the conversation. See where you are in setup and your next step, and ask BillDog support without leaving the chat. Journeys can be activated and paused from the conversation. On a live project, changes that reach app users wait for an owner or admin, who is emailed a link to review them. Setup code for iOS and Android now handles every paywall result.
